DISCOVERY 610, SUBMITTED ON TENTATIVE RULING. NO APPEARANCE BY DEFENDANT. THE COURT WILL CONSIDER THE MOTION AS BROUGHT PURSUANT TO PARAGRAPH (N) OF SECTION 2031 OF THE CODE OF CIVIL PROCEDURE SINCE DEFENDANTS PREVIOUSLY RESPONDED BY AGREEING TO PRODUCE SPECIFIED DOCUMENTS AND PLAINTIFF DOES NOT CONTEST THE VALIDITY OF THE OBJECTIONS OR THE SUFFICIENCY OF INDIVIDUAL RESPONSES. ACCORDINGLY, THE COURT WILL EXCUSE THE FAILURE TO SUBMIT A SEPARATE STATEMENT OF MATTERS IN DISPUTE PURSUANT TO CALIFORNIA RULE OF COURT 335 AND THE ATTEMPT AT AN INFORMAL RESOLUTION OF THE ISSUES DURING THE PERIOD SUBJECT TO THE PROPERLY FILED NOTICE OF UNAVAILABILITY OF COUNSEL. PLAINTIFF'S MOTION TO COMPEL COMPLIANCE WITH THE REQUEST FOR PRODUCTION OF DOCUMENTS IS GRANTED AS TO CATEGORIES #1 - 26 AND #31 - 32. IF ALL RESPONSIVE DOCUMENTS IN THIS ACTION HAVE PREVIOUSLY BEEN PRODUCED PURSUANT TO DISCOVERY CONDUCTED IN CASE # 429498, DEFENDANT SHALL VERIFY THAT REPRESENTATION. ANY DOCUMENTS WITHHELD PURSUANT TO A CLAIM OF PRIVILEGE SHALL BE IDENTIFIED WITH PARTICULARITY IN A PRIVILEGE LOG. DEFENDANT IS ORDERED TO PRODUCE ALL RESPONSIVE DOCUMENTS WITHIN 15 DAYS OF NOTICE OF THIS ORDER. THE COURT ORDERS THE PARTIES TO MEET AND CONFER AS TO ITEMS #27 - 30 TO DISCUSS LIMITING THE SCOPE OF THE REQUEST IN LIGHT OF THE ASSERTION OF THE RIGHT TO PRIVACY IN PERSONAL FINANCIAL INFORMATION. THE REQUEST FOR SANCTIONS IS DENIED. ORDER SIGNED. COMM: BRUCE E. CHAN
